READ_DIAGNOSE.description: Read bounded repository/provider state and construct diagnostics.

PROPOSE_CHANGESET.description: Construct candidate file changes without external mutation.

WRITE_BRANCH.description: Create/update a non-protected development branch in the verified workspace.

OPEN_PR.description: Open a pull request for an already approved candidate.

MERGE.description: Merge a pull request or otherwise mutate protected/default branch state.

SECRETS.description: Create, rotate, expose or modify credentials/secrets.

MATERIAL_SPEND.description: Start operations that can materially increase external cost.

rules: Approval binds to an exact candidate/change-set version.
Write authority never implies merge/deploy authority.
Provider dispatch never equals verification PASS.
